## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0342-power-of-four.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def isPowerOfFour(self, n: int) -> bool:
        rem = n % 4

        if n == 1:
            return True

        if rem != 0 or n <= 0:
            return False

        while n > 1 and rem == 0:
            n = n // 4
            rem = n % 4

        if rem != 0 and n > 1:
            return False

        return True
```

</details>
